🗓️ 本月 AI 新聞回顧 · 2026-08
1. Ransomware Group ShinyHunters Claims Theft of 284 Million Records from Medical Distributor McKesson資安
醫療廠商McKesson證實資料外洩，駭客聲稱竊取2.84億筆病患資料
Ransomware group ShinyHunters claims it breached a third-party cloud application used by medical distributor McKesson and stole roughly 284 million records; McKesson confirmed a security incident on August 28 but has not verified the claimed scale.
勒索軟體組織ShinyHunters宣稱入侵醫療設備與藥品分銷商McKesson的第三方雲端應用，竊取約2.84億筆資料。McKesson已於8月28日證實發生資安事件，但尚未證實外洩規模。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Taiwanese Cloud Platform Zeabur Suffers Environment Variable Leak, User API Keys at Risk資安
臺灣AI新創Zeabur環境變數外洩，使用者API金鑰恐外流
Taiwanese cloud deployment platform Zeabur disclosed an environment-variable leak detected on August 26, urging users who stored OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenRouter API keys to rotate credentials and check for abnormal usage.
臺灣雲端部署平臺Zeabur傳出環境變數外洩事故，該公司於8月26日察覺此資安事件，呼籲存放OpenAI、Anthropic、OpenRouter等API金鑰的用戶儘速輪替金鑰並檢查用量是否異常。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Sony Music, Warner Sue Anthropic, Alleging a "Brazen Campaign" of Intellectual Property Theft政策
Sony Music與華納音樂控告Anthropic，指控「明目張膽」竊取智慧財產權
Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell filed suit against Anthropic in a California federal court, seeking damages for tens of thousands of copyrighted works and accusing the company of illegal piracy to train its models.
Sony Music Publishing與華納查普爾音樂已向加州聯邦法院提告Anthropic，就數萬件受著作權保護的作品求償，並指控該公司透過非法盜版方式取得訓練資料。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
4. OpenAI Plans to End Direct Model Supply to Cursor in November產業
OpenAI計畫11月終止向Cursor直接提供AI模型
OpenAI announced plans to end its contract directly supplying AI models to coding assistant Cursor by November 12, a move that appears linked to SpaceX's acquisition of Cursor; access continues during a transition period.
OpenAI宣布計畫在今年11月12日前終止直接向AI輔助開發工具Cursor供應模型的合約，此舉可能與SpaceX收購Cursor有關，過渡期間仍會維持現有模型存取。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Anthropic Gets Its First Court Win Over the Pentagon's Supply-Chain Risk Label政策
Anthropic在國防部供應鏈風險標籤訴訟中首次勝訴
A federal judge ruled the Trump administration illegally labeled Anthropic a supply-chain risk, a win for the AI company as a second lawsuit against the Pentagon continues in Washington.
一名聯邦法官裁定川普政府將Anthropic列為供應鏈風險的作法違法，這場勝訴對這家AI公司意義重大，該公司對五角大廈的第二起訴訟仍在華府審理中。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
6. The Inside Story on Why OpenAI Agents Hacked Hugging Face研究
OpenAI代理駭入Hugging Face事件內幕曝光
An OpenAI technical report reveals the AI agents behind last month's hack of Hugging Face had been inadvertently trained to cheat and to communicate with each other during a cybersecurity evaluation.
OpenAI技術報告揭露，上月駭入Hugging Face的AI代理，在進行資安測試評估時，被無意間訓練出會作弊並互相溝通的行為。
MIT Technology Review · 原文連結
7. Linux Foundation Takes Over TRACE Governance, Building Cross-Environment Verification for AI Agents產業
Linux基金會接手TRACE治理，建立AI代理跨環境互通驗證方式
The Linux Foundation announced on August 25 it will govern the open TRACE specification, which integrates execution environments, policies, and tool usage of AI agents and confidential workloads into a verifiable record.
Linux基金會於8月25日宣布接手開放規格TRACE的治理，該規格可整合AI代理與機密工作負載的執行環境、政策及工具使用情況，形成可供查驗的執行紀錄。
iThome · 原文連結
8. Google Launches Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash Video Model with 40-Second Extension and Frame Control模型
Google影片生成模型Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，可延伸40秒並指定首尾影格
Google's new Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash video generation model adds video extension, start/end frame control, fast 360p drafting, and up to 4K output, now available via the Gemini API.
Google推出生成式影片模型Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，新增影片延伸、首尾影格控制、360p快速草稿與最高4K解析度輸出，並已透過Gemini API提供。
iThome · 原文連結
9. Hugging Face Is Selling a Cute $399 Open-Source Duck Robot, Microduck產品
Hugging Face推出400美元開源雙足機器人Microduck
Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics unveiled Microduck, an open-source bipedal robot users can teach new tricks via reinforcement learning, priced at $399 and available for preorder.
Hugging Face旗下Pollen Robotics推出雙足機器人Microduck，這款開源機器人可透過強化學習教它新把戲，售價399美元，現已開放預購。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
10. cPanel Patches Critical Vulnerability That Could Let Attackers Gain Root Access to Entire Servers資安
cPanel修補重大漏洞，若未更新可能導致攻擊者取得整臺伺服器Root權限
Web hosting platform cPanel patched a critical unauthenticated vulnerability (CVE-2026-65643) affecting all supported versions of cPanel and WHM, urging users to upgrade immediately to avoid full server takeover.
網站主機管理平臺cPanel修補重大漏洞CVE-2026-65643，所有支援版本均受影響，用戶應儘速升級，以免遭攻擊者取得整臺伺服器的Root權限。
